name: pdfweave-monorepo
description: PDFweave — a PDF template engine with first-class data binding, anchor layouts, smart tables, and stationery PDFs. Forked from PDFme.
author: hand-dot

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build -w packages/pdf-lib && npm run build -w packages/common && npm run build -w packages/converter && npm run build -w packages/schemas && ./scripts/build-workspaces-in-parallel.sh packages/generator packages/imposition packages/ui packages/manipulator && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:strict && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run coverage:check && npm run build && npm --prefix playground run build && npm --prefix playground run test
scripts.fmt: vp run --filter '@pdfweave/*' fmt && npm --prefix playground run fmt && npm run fmt:meta
scripts.fmt:check: vp fmt -c .oxfmtrc.json packages/cli/src packages/common/src packages/converter/src packages/generator/src packages/imposition/src packages/manipulator/src packages/pdf-lib/src packages/schemas/src packages/ui/src playground/src playground/e2e playground/vite.config.ts playground/vitest.setup.ts playground/postcss.config.js playground/tailwind.config.js package.json packages/cli/package.json packages/common/package.json packages/converter/package.json packages/generator/package.json packages/imposition/package.json packages/manipulator/package.json packages/pdf-lib/package.json packages/schemas/package.json packages/ui/package.json playground/package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json playground/.oxlintrc.json vite.config.mts --check
scripts.fmt:meta: vp fmt -c .oxfmtrc.json package.json packages/cli/package.json packages/common/package.json packages/converter/package.json packages/generator/package.json packages/imposition/package.json packages/manipulator/package.json packages/pdf-lib/package.json packages/schemas/package.json packages/ui/package.json playground/package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json playground/.oxlintrc.json vite.config.mts --write
scripts.test: node packages/common/set-version.js && vp run --filter '@pdfweave/*' test && npm run test:qualification-report
scripts.test:render-artifacts: node packages/common/set-version.js && npm run test:render-artifacts -w packages/generator && npm run test:render-artifacts -w packages/imposition
scripts.lint: vp run --filter '@pdfweave/*' lint && npm --prefix playground run lint
scripts.lint:fix: vp lint -c .oxlintrc.json packages/cli/src packages/common/src packages/converter/src packages/generator/src packages/imposition/src packages/manipulator/src packages/pdf-lib/src packages/schemas/src packages/ui/src --fix && npm --prefix playground run lint -- --fix
